job.title: Lead Heath & Safety Advisor
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are recruiting an experienced Senior HSE Lead to join an established Civil Engineering Contractor working on a range of major Water Infrastructure projects across Cork City and County.

The successful candidate will oversee Health, Safety and Environmental operations across multiple projects, primarily involving new and upgrades to exisiting water infrastructure works.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced HSE professional to take on a senior position within an established HSE team, providing guidance and support to Junior and Intermediate HSE personnel.

The role will involve a mixture of site visits and office-based work, with several office locations available across Cork City and County.

The position is open to both permanent and contract candidates, with an initial project pipeline of at c. 12 months and excellent opportunities for longer-term career development.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee HSE operations across multiple water infrastructure and pumping station projects.
  • Provide leadership, guidance and support to Junior and Intermediate HSE personnel.
  • Ensure compliance with Irish Health, Safety and Environmental legislation.
  • Conduct regular site inspections, audits and risk assessments.
  • Monitor contractor compliance with project-specific HSE requirements and procedures.
  • Liaise with Project Managers, Site Teams and senior management.
  • Promote a strong safety culture across all project locations.
  • Oversee incident investigations, reporting and corrective actions where required.

Requirements

  • 8+ years' experience in Construction Health and Safety.
  • Strong background within Civil Engineering or major infrastructure projects in Ireland/UK.
  • Previous experience overseeing HSE operations across multiple construction sites.
  • Water infrastructure, pumping stations or utilities experience highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with Uisce Éireann (Irish Water) standards highly advantageous.
  • Relevant Health and Safety qualification, ideally at degree or diploma level.
  • Excellent communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience within the Irish or UK Construction market is essential.

Salary & Benefits

  • Strong salary or contract rate, depending on experience.
  • Flexible permanent or contract employment options available.
  • Opportunity to join an established and experienced HSE team.
  • Mixture of site-based and office-based responsibilities across Cork.
  • Excellent opportunities for long-term career development and progression.

job.description:
Support Pharmacist - Tuam, Co. Galway (Maternity Contract)

I am currently recruiting a Support Pharmacist for Galway. This position is for 4 or 5 days a week, with 1 Saturday in 3. There is excellent support and conditions.

To support the Managing Pharmacist in the running of the dispensary in a busy and challenging environment. Working to agreed operating procedures within the pharmacy to maintain the highest ethical standards and deliver excellent customer care.

Duties and Responsibilities:­­­­ ­­­­­­­ ­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­ ­

  • To strictly observe the statutory regulations relating to the supply of medicinal products as per the Pharmacy Act 2007.
  • To adhere to dispensing standard operating procedures and ensure maintenance of the appropriate records and hygiene within the pharmacy as per the Pharmacy Act 2008.
  • To ensure that any issues of a Health and Safety nature are brought to the attention of the managing pharmacist.
  • To fulfil the required advisory role concerning over-the-counter medicines and ensure that staff on the medicine counter are aware of the procedure for counter prescribing and their limitations.

job.title: Employment Case Worker
job.description:
Employment Caseworker required to work in our Tipperary Offices (3 days Tipp town and 2 days Clonmel).

Monday-Friday 09:00-05:00(on-site)
We are looking for candidates with strong customer service and administration experience.
You will need to drive as you will have to travel for this role

ABOUT TURAS NUA
IPNES supports people who are over 12 months unemployed or employed part-time on low earnings, by providing intensive, targeted and personalised employment support services. The IPNES contract is delivered by Turas Nua, the Irish employability services provider. Turas Nua is wholly owned by FRS Network, an Irish cooperative social enterprise, which has been delivering services to Irish communities since 1980.


PURPOSE OF ROLE
As a caseworker, you will work with clients referred by the Department of Social Protection to IPNES. You will manage a caseload of clients, coordinating our internal support specialists and external organisations to provide a personalised, planned support service to each client, to help them gain sustainable employment. You will also provide each client with one-to-one advice and support to guide their progress towards employment.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and manage a robust case management plan for each client, working towards sustainable, full-time employment.
  • use our industry-leading assessment technology to identify the client’s goals, ambitions, and barriers to employment. Use the output from the assessment to inform a structured personal progression plan, agreed with the client.
  • Recognise hidden motivations and conflict when assessing clients’ job-readiness, in order to address these with appropriate support and interventions.
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to clients, including providing intensive job search support when the client is job ready.
  • Identify, structure, and recommend training solutions in consultation with in-house tutors, to meet the specific learning and training needs of clients.
  • Fast-track job-ready clients for immediate job interviews brokered by our Employer Services consultants.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of the local labour market.
  • Organise a daily schedule that includes face-to-face meetings, phone calls, online meetings, and email correspondence with clients and other service providers.
  • Work closely with local and national specialist services (e.g., training, literacy, housing, health) to assist the client in their journey towards employment.
  • Present and facilitate workshops and group-learning presentations to clients weekly.
  • Achieve daily and monthly contractual key performance indicator (KPI) targets, managing a caseload of clients; for example, time-bound contacts, assessments, and support activities.
  • Provide guidance and support for more job-ready clients during their initial weeks of employment, helping them to successfully transition to sustainable employment.
  • Ensure that client interactions are recorded accurately on the CRM system.
  • Ensure data protection regulations are fully adhered to.


ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Leaving Certificate or equivalent.
  • Minimum of three years’ experience of working in a customer focused, target driven environment.
  • Strong IT skills/experience in the use of Microsoft office and CRM systems. Must be comfortable with all aspects of remote working technology.
  • Excellent administrative skills – fast & accurate data entry skills.
  • The ability to build rapport and work effectively with a diverse range of individuals both in person and over the phone.
  • Experience in delivering presentations in a group setting or public speaking.
  • Strong prioritisation and time management skills.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.

job.title: Finance Manager
job.description:
Finance Manager

Cork | Permanent

About the role

We are recruiting a Finance Manager for an established and growing distribution business based in Cork.

This is a broad, hands on role combining financial reporting, financial control and commercial business partnering. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will take responsibility for the finance function in Ireland, working closely with senior management and the wider UK finance team.

You will play a key role in monitoring financial performance, identifying opportunities to improve profitability and providing the financial insight needed to support business decisions and long term growth.

Key responsibilities

  • Prepare monthly management accounts, balance sheet and cash flow statements.

  • Maintain effective financial policies, procedures and internal controls, ensuring compliance with relevant legislation and accounting standards.

  • Lead budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis to monitor business performance against targets.

  • Prepare and analyse sales and margin forecasts, identifying trends and opportunities to improve profitability.

  • Work closely with senior management on business strategy, cost savings and cost avoidance.

  • Analyse sales, customer and market profitability to support commercial decision making.

  • Partner with the sales team to ensure customer agreements are accurately costed and recorded.

  • Oversee customer rebates and commercial agreements, ensuring they are financially sound.

  • Provide financial analysis and return on investment calculations to support business cases.

  • Coordinate the annual audit and liaise with external auditors.

  • Oversee financial systems administration and provide financial information to support the wider business.

  • Manage and develop a team of two Credit Controllers.

  • Ensure appropriate due diligence is completed when assessing customer credit terms and facilities.

About you

  • A recognised professional accounting qualification with at least five years' experience in a similar finance role.

  • Strong experience in financial reporting, management accounts, budgeting and forecasting.

  • Commercially minded, with a strong understanding of costing, margins and profitability.

  • Proven ability to interpret financial data and translate it into practical recommendations for management.

  • Experience supporting senior stakeholders with commercial and strategic decisions.

  • Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel capability.

  • Previous people management experience.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across different functions and finance teams.

  • A proactive, hands on approach, with strong attention to detail and a commitment to effective financial controls.

  • Experience in distribution, wholesale, foodservice or a similar commercial environment would be an advantage.

Salary and benefits

Competitive salary and benefits package, to be confirmed.

job.title: Cath Lab Nurse
job.description:
Job Description

Job Title: CNM1 and Staff Nurse

Department: Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory
Reports to: Nurse Manager / CNM2
Date: 2026

Overall Purpose of the Role

The organisation is committed to providing exceptional patient care within an environment where quality, respect, compassion and dignity are central to all aspects of care delivery.

The Clinical Coordinator is responsible for coordinating, directing and overseeing the day-to-day clinical and operational activities of the Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory. The post holder will work collaboratively with the Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory team and the wider Cardiology multidisciplinary team to ensure the delivery of safe, effective and high-quality patient care.

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables

The Clinical Coordinator will:

  • Coordinate and oversee the daily delivery of patient care within the unit.

  • Assess patient care requirements and analyse workload and staffing needs to ensure appropriate allocation of resources.

  • Assess staff competencies and allocate patient care responsibilities appropriately.

  • Delegate duties and responsibilities in accordance with legal and professional requirements, departmental policies and established standards.

  • Maintain effective communication with the Nurse Manager regarding operational requirements, patient care concerns, staffing issues and incidents.

  • Act as a clinical and professional resource for staff within the unit.

  • Provide direct patient care and clinical support when required.

  • Identify and maintain appropriate internal controls within the department and contribute to mechanisms that monitor compliance.

  • Ensure adherence to departmental policies, procedures, guidelines and internal controls.

  • Undertake other duties appropriate to the role as required.

Clinical Responsibilities

The post holder will:

  • Practise in accordance with the relevant professional standards and the Professional Scope of Practice Framework issued by the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI).

  • Maintain a high standard of clinical practice and professional conduct.

  • Promote safe, evidence-based and patient-centred care.

  • Ensure that patient care is delivered in accordance with organisational policies, procedures and clinical guidelines.

  • Support the delivery of high-quality care within the Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory.

  • Escalate clinical concerns and patient safety issues appropriately and promptly.

Managerial Responsibilities

The post holder will:

  • Identify and communicate operational, clinical and staffing issues to the Nurse Manager in a timely manner.

  • Demonstrate knowledge and competence in relevant organisational policies, procedures and clinical guidelines.

  • Ensure that all required clinical and operational documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner.

  • Respond appropriately to patient and service-user complaints and escalate concerns where necessary.

  • Monitor and contribute to risk management processes within the department.

  • Promote effective communication and collaboration across the multidisciplinary team.

  • Ensure the efficient and appropriate use of human, financial and other departmental resources.

  • Participate in unit and hospital-wide nursing communication processes.

  • Support the Nurse Manager in maintaining effective standards of service delivery.

Supervisory Responsibilities

The post holder will:

  • Allocate patient workloads appropriately, taking into consideration patient acuity, clinical requirements, staff competence and skill mix.

  • Provide direct and indirect supervision to Staff Nurses, Healthcare Assistants and unit reception staff as appropriate.

  • Monitor the delivery of patient care and provide guidance and support to staff.

  • Promote a safe, supportive and professional working environment.

  • Identify and escalate performance, competency or staffing concerns appropriately.

Interprofessional Relationships

The post holder will:

  • Develop and maintain effective working relationships with all relevant departments, medical staff, patients, families and external agencies.

  • Maintain effective communication with the Nurse Manager and Nurse Supervisor throughout the shift.

  • Demonstrate effective delegation of duties and responsibilities.

  • Participate in ongoing consultation and collaboration with physicians and other members of the multidisciplinary team to optimise patient outcomes and achieve unit-specific objectives.

  • Promote effective communication and teamwork within the clinical environment.

  • Demonstrate a willingness to support colleagues and assist with workload when required.

  • Promote a culture of respect, professionalism and collaborative practice.

Quality Improvement and Risk Management

The post holder will actively participate in quality management and continuous improvement processes, contributing to:

  • The identification and review of quality, policy and guideline issues.

  • The evaluation of current clinical practices against evidence-based and best-practice standards.

  • The development and implementation of appropriate clinical and operational standards using structure, process and outcome measures.

  • Hospital, regional and national audit processes.

  • Accreditation and quality-assurance processes.

  • Health promotion and patient education initiatives.

  • The identification and implementation of opportunities to improve patient safety, quality of care and service delivery.

  • The monitoring and review of clinical risks and implementation of appropriate risk-reduction measures.

  • Educational Responsibilities

Under the direction of the Nurse Manager, the post holder will:

  • Develop and utilise effective teaching and facilitation skills within the clinical environment.

  • Participate in the planning, implementation and evaluation of orientation and clinical teaching programmes for student nurses.

  • Provide appropriate feedback to Nurse Managers to support the completion of student nurse proficiency assessments.

  • Contribute to the identification of education and training needs within the clinical area.

  • Identify and contribute to the development of learning opportunities for staff within the department.

  • Participate in the clinical induction and orientation of newly appointed nursing and support staff.

  • Develop leadership skills and act as a positive and effective professional role model.

  • Support staff development through appropriate coaching, supervision and feedback.

  • Take responsibility for identifying and addressing personal learning and professional development needs.

Person Specification

Qualifications

Essential:

  • Current registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI) as a Registered General Nurse, with registration maintained in good standing.

  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.

  • Current Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certification.

Desirable:

  • Relevant postgraduate qualification or specialist education in cardiology, cardiac nursing, cardiac catheterisation or a related area.

  • Where a relevant postgraduate qualification is not currently held, willingness to undertake an appropriate postgraduate programme within 18 months of commencing the Clinical Coordinator role.

Experience

The successful candidate will ideally have:

  • A minimum of two years' relevant clinical experience within a Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory.

  • Demonstrable experience in clinical leadership and coordination.

  • Experience in teaching, mentoring and supporting nursing and healthcare staff.

  • Experience of working effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

  • Demonstrable professional judgement and the ability to make appropriate clinical decisions.

  • Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • The ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks effectively within a busy clinical environment.

  • Effective time-management and organisational skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • A commitment to continuing professional development and lifelong learning.

  • The ability to communicate effectively in written and spoken English, with a high standard of grammar and professional communication.

To know more contact Sonal Tikariha

job.title: Employment Caseworker
job.description:
Employment Caseworker required to work in our Turas Nua Kilkenny Office

Monday-Friday 09:00-05:00(on-site)

We are looking for candidates with strong customer service and administration experience.

ABOUT TURAS NUA

IPNES supports people who are over 12 months unemployed or employed part-time on low earnings, by providing intensive, targeted and personalised employment support services. The IPNES contract is delivered by Turas Nua, the Irish employability services provider. Turas Nua is wholly owned by FRS Network, an Irish cooperative social enterprise, which has been delivering services to Irish communities since 1980.

PURPOSE OF ROLE

As an Employment Caseworker, you will work with clients referred by the Department of Social Protection to IPNES. You will manage a caseload of clients, coordinating our internal support specialists and external organisations to provide a personalised, planned support service to each client, to help them gain sustainable employment. You will also provide each client with one-to-one advice and support to guide their progress towards employment.

PERSON PROFILE

  • A dynamic and adaptable person who can work in a fast-paced, client-focused and results driven environment. You will possess strong case management capabilities including, decision-making skills, relationship skills and problem-solving skills.
  • Able to build rapport and trust with clients and motivate them to own their journey and achieve change.
  • Highly self-motivated and able to work in an office and remotely as part of a team.
  • Able to provide individual support to each client based on their particular needs. This requires a high level of understanding, patience and empathy, active listening skills and the ability to navigate more difficult conversations/interactions with professionalism and sensitivity.
  • Able to deliver a high-quality service which creates positive outcomes for the individuals and the communities with which we work.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and manage a robust case management plan for each client, working towards sustainable, full-time employment.
  • use our industry-leading assessment technology to identify the client’s goals, ambitions, and barriers to employment. Use the output from the assessment to inform a structured personal progression plan, agreed with the client.
  • Recognise hidden motivations and conflict when assessing clients’ job-readiness, in order to address these with appropriate support and interventions.
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to clients, including providing intensive job search support when the client is job ready.
  • Identify, structure, and recommend training solutions in consultation with in-house tutors, to meet the specific learning and training needs of clients.
  • Fast-track job-ready clients for immediate job interviews brokered by our Employer Services consultants.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of the local labour market.
  • Organise a daily schedule that includes face-to-face meetings, phone calls, online meetings, and email correspondence with clients and other service providers.
  • Work closely with local and national specialist services (e.g., training, literacy, housing, health) to assist the client in their journey towards employment.
  • Present and facilitate workshops and group-learning presentations to clients weekly.
  • Achieve daily and monthly contractual key performance indicator (KPI) targets, managing a caseload of clients; for example, time-bound contacts, assessments, and support activities.
  • Provide guidance and support for more job-ready clients during their initial weeks of employment, helping them to successfully transition to sustainable employment.
  • Ensure that client interactions are recorded accurately on the CRM system.
  • Ensure data protection regulations are fully adhered to.

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Leaving Certificate or equivalent.
  • Minimum of three years’ experience of working in a customer focused, target driven environment.
  • Strong IT skills/experience in the use of Microsoft office.
  • Excellent administrative skills – fast & accurate data entry skills.
  • The ability to build rapport and work effectively with a diverse range of individuals both in person and over the phone.
  • Experience in delivering presentations is desirable but not essential.
  • Strong prioritisation and time management skills.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.

Recruiter: Amee Mullen

INDFRS1

Kildare | €50,000–€59,000 DOE + Bonus + Pension + Healthcare

Are you a qualified Mechanical Fitter looking for your next move in Kildare, Carlow, Kilkenny, Laois or South Kildare? Do you enjoy fault finding, problem solving and working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment?

If so, this could be an excellent opportunity to join a global leader in beverage manufacturing at an exciting stage of growth.

The Company

My client is a leading multinational beverage manufacturer supplying products across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Following significant investment and a major site expansion, they are now looking to add a Mechanical Fitter to their engineering team.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you'll be responsible for maintaining plant and equipment, reducing downtime and ensuring machinery operates safely and efficiently in line with GMP, HACCP and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Carry out planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and continuous improvement activities.

What You'll Need

  • Trade qualification in Mechanical Fitting, Maintenance, Mechatronics or similar.
  • 3+ years' maintenance experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong mechanical fault-finding skills with experience of high-speed production equipment.
  • Knowledge of Allen Bradley PLCs, Ethernet/IP, ControlNet, DeviceNet or Profibus is desirable.
  • Experience with SCADA systems and ATEX environments would be an advantage.
  • Good IT skills and experience using CMMS or ERP systems.

What's in it for You?

  • €50,000–€59,000 DOE
  • Bonus
  • Pension
  • Health insurance
  • 23 days annual leave
  • Excellent training and career progression opportunities

This is a fantastic time to join the business. Following a major investment programme, the site has recently undergone a significant upgrade, with further expansion plans already underway. You'll enjoy the culture and visibility of a medium-sized operation while benefiting from the stability and career opportunities that come with being part of a large US multinational.

Apply Today

job.title: Employment Case Worker
job.description:
Employment Caseworker required for our Kilkenny office.

Monday-Friday 09:00-05:00

We are looking for candidates with strong customer service and administration experience.

ABOUT TURAS NUA

IPNES supports people who are over 12 months unemployed or employed part-time on low earnings, by providing intensive, targeted and personalised employment support services. The IPNES contract is delivered by Turas Nua, the Irish employability services provider. Turas Nua is wholly owned by FRS Network, an Irish cooperative social enterprise, which has been delivering services to Irish communities since 1980.

ABOUT DEPARTMENT

IPNES supports people who are over 12 months unemployed or employed part-time on low earnings, by providing intensive, targeted and personalised employment support services. The IPNES contract is delivered by Turas Nua, the Irish employability services provider. Turas Nua is wholly owned by FRS Network, an Irish cooperative social enterprise, which has been delivering services to Irish communities since 1980.

PURPOSE OF ROLE

As a caseworker, you will work with clients referred by the Department of Social Protection to IPNES. You will manage a caseload of clients, coordinating our internal support specialists and external organisations to provide a personalised, planned support service to each client, to help them gain sustainable employment. You will also provide each client with one-to-one advice and support to guide their progress towards employment.

PERSON PROFILE

  • A dynamic and adaptable person who can work in a fast-paced, client-focused and results driven environment. You will possess strong case management capabilities including, decision-making skills, relationship skills and problem-solving skills.
  • Able to build rapport and trust with clients and motivate them to own their journey and achieve change.
  • Highly self-motivated and able to work in an office and remotely as part of a team.
  • Able to provide individual support to each client based on their particular needs. This requires a high level of understanding, patience and empathy, active listening skills and the ability to navigate more difficult conversations/interactions with professionalism and sensitivity.
  • Able to deliver a high-quality service which creates positive outcomes for the individuals and the communities with which we work.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and manage a robust case management plan for each client, working towards sustainable, full-time employment.
  • use our industry-leading assessment technology to identify the client’s goals, ambitions, and barriers to employment. Use the output from the assessment to inform a structured personal progression plan, agreed with the client.
  • Recognise hidden motivations and conflict when assessing clients’ job-readiness, in order to address these with appropriate support and interventions.
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to clients, including providing intensive job search support when the client is job ready.
  • Identify, structure, and recommend training solutions in consultation with in-house tutors, to meet the specific learning and training needs of clients.
  • Fast-track job-ready clients for immediate job interviews brokered by our Employer Services consultants.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of the local labour market.
  • Organise a daily schedule that includes face-to-face meetings, phone calls, online meetings, and email correspondence with clients and other service providers.
  • Work closely with local and national specialist services (e.g., training, literacy, housing, health) to assist the client in their journey towards employment.
  • Present and facilitate workshops and group-learning presentations to clients weekly.
  • Achieve daily and monthly contractual key performance indicator (KPI) targets, managing a caseload of clients; for example, time-bound contacts, assessments, and support activities.
  • Provide guidance and support for more job-ready clients during their initial weeks of employment, helping them to successfully transition to sustainable employment.
  • Ensure that client interactions are recorded accurately on the CRM system.
  • Ensure data protection regulations are fully adhered to.

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Leaving Certificate or equivalent.
  • Minimum of three years’ experience of working in a customer focused, target driven environment.
  • Strong IT skills/experience in the use of Microsoft office.
  • Excellent administrative skills – fast & accurate data entry skills.
  • The ability to build rapport and work effectively with a diverse range of individuals both in person and over the phone.
  • Experience in delivering presentations in a group (desirable not essential)
  • Strong prioritisation and time management skills.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.

Recruiter: Joyce Coffey

job.title: Agri Mill Operative
job.description:
Mill Operator / Production Operator

Kinsale, Co. Cork

FRS Recruitment is hiring on behalf of a leading Irish agribusiness for a Mill Operator / Production Operator to join their busy feed mill operation in Kinsale. This position would suit someone with experience in production, manufacturing, agricultural processing, feed milling, or machinery operation who is mechanically minded and comfortable working with computerised production systems.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established and successful business that offers long-term career stability, training, overtime opportunities, and performance-related bonuses.

The Role

Reporting to the Production Manager, the successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the safe, efficient, and consistent operation of the feed mill. You will be involved throughout the production process, from raw material intake and processing through to the production of finished animal feed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate and monitor computerised production and process control systems.
  • Manage batching, mixing, pelleting, and heat treatment processes.
  • Monitor product quality, production targets, and plant performance.
  • Manage the movement and storage of raw materials and finished products.
  • Carry out routine plant inspections, cleaning, and basic maintenance activities.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and report mechanical or production issues.
  • Maintain accurate production, quality, and cleaning records.
  • Adhere to all health & safety, feed safety, quality assurance, and traceability procedures.
  • Assist with manual handling and general production duties as required.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives within the mill operation.

Candidate Requirements

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Experience in feed milling, food production, agricultural processing, manufacturing, or a similar production environment.
  • Experience operating computerised production or process control systems.
  • Good mechanical aptitude with the ability to perform basic maintenance tasks.
  • Strong awareness of health and safety procedures.
  • Good attention to detail and record-keeping skills.
  • The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Flexibility to work additional hours during peak seasonal periods.
  • Forklift or loader experience would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?

  • Permanent, full-time position.
  • Guaranteed minimum of 40 hours per week.
  • Day shifts only with no night work required.
  • Typical start times of 6:00am or 7:00am, depending on seasonal production requirements.
  • Overtime opportunities available during busy periods and paid at time and a half.
  • Weekly performance-related bonus linked to production targets and KPIs.
  • Competitive hourly rate, dependent on experience and suitability.
  • Full training provided on site-specific equipment, plant, and systems.
  • Opportunity to build a long-term career within a growing and well-established Irish agribusiness.

Apply

If you have experience in production, manufacturing, agricultural operations, feed milling, or machinery operation and are looking for a secure, hands-on role with excellent long-term prospects, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today through FRS Recruitment for a confidential discussion and further details.

This is a progressive, forward thinking company who value all their staff and are committed to providing an inclusive and enjoyable working environment.

The Opportunity

Due to continued growth, they are seeking an experienced Commercial Account Executive to join their expanding Commercial team. This is an excellent opportunity to join a close-knit, customer-focused brokerage where you'll manage a diverse portfolio of SME commercial clients, build long-term relationships and play an integral role in the continued success of the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of SME commercial clients across a broad range of industries.
  • Handle new business, renewals and mid-term adjustments from initial enquiry through to policy placement.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients by providing expert insurance advice and exceptional customer service.
  • Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.

  • Prepare and present insurance quotations and renewal terms.
  • Work closely with underwriters and insurer partners to secure appropriate cover.
  • Ensure all documentation and client records are maintained accurately and in line with Central Bank regulations.
  • Maintain a high level of technical knowledge across commercial insurance products and market developments.
  • Support colleagues and contribute to the continued growth of the commercial team.

About You

  • Previous experience in Commercial Insurance within a brokerage or insurer.
  • Strong knowledge of SME commercial insurance products including Property, Liability, Motor Fleet, Professional Indemnity and Commercial Combined.
  • Experience managing renewals, new business and client relationships.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail.
  • Customer-focused with a proactive and solution-driven approach.
  • APA Commercial qualified as a minimum; CIP qualification desirable or working towards.

Benefits:

  • Competitive Salary commensurate with experience (Wages paid weekly)
  • Additional bonus and commission Structure
  • Hybrid option after probation/training
  • Company Pension scheme
  • Death in service benefit insurance plan
  • 22 days annual leave
  • Examinations/further study sponsored where relevant to the role
  • Opportunity to enhance your career in multiple areas of the insurance industry

Why Apply?

job.title: Farm Maintenance Mechanic Manager
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are currently recruiting for a Farm Maintenance Manager (Machinery) for a large farm operation in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time permanent role.

Remuneration package

  • 97 days annual leave a year.
  • 6 free flights per year to and from Saudi Arabia
  • Accommodation Provided
  • Tax Free Salaries and Bonus
  • Vehicle
  • VIP Medical Cover

You will have responsibility and autonomy for scheduling maintenance for multiple Dairy farms. Our client is one of the largest vertically integrated dairy companies in the Middle East, managing over 195,000 dairy cows across seven modern dairy farms.

The FMM will work closely with farm workshop staff and demonstrate areas of improvement that can reduce costs / improve performance and reduce downtime on equipment. This will be a hands-on role where you will work with a multicultural workforce with a varying degree of ability.

The FMM will work side by side with the workshop team and transfer knowledge to them and help to improve their skills & ensure that the farm staff always keep updated service records.

Please note the ideal candidate for this role will be proficient in reading electrical and hydraulic drawings as you will be the contact for all mechanics when a breakdown arises.

Job overview

To plan and organize assigned farm mechanical maintenance staff so that the broad range of agricultural, industrial and animal feeding machinery and equipment is serviced, maintained and operated in accordance with company procedure. Train staff to ensure that competent and sufficient numbers of maintenance staff are available for the assigned farm sites.

Duties to include

  • To ensure that all maintenance staff are organised, trained and carry out all maintenance in accordance with all company Maintenance and Safety procedures for all farm agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment.
  • To ensure that all maintenance tasks are carried out in a safe manner and in accordance with company policy and standards.
  • To ensure all workshop buildings and surrounding areas, tools, lifting equipment and electrical equipment are in a clean and safe working condition.
  • To minimise the level of unplanned stoppages of machinery and reduce production losses due to machinery or equipment downtime.
  • To oversee routine and preventative maintenance of all agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment within the Division.
  • To monitor and assess the performance of all maintenance staff in conjunction with the Farming and Maintenance Manager and recommend training as require.
  • Liaise with suppliers to arrange warranty repairs.
  • Report issues that affect the reliability and running costs of equipment.
  • Arrange OEM training and access to required manuals for workshop staff.
  • Update company manuals that are used for maintaining and servicing machinery. Ensure that workshop staff are always following company manuals for servicing.
  • Identify parts that should be kept in the workshop central store that are necessary to keep equipment running. Ensure that the workshop store does not carry obsolete stock.
  • Navigate different manufacturers parts manuals / systems.
  • Arrange quotations from suppliers for the repair of equipment.

Core competencies

  • Excellent communicator with good influencing and person management skills.
  • A sound knowledge of troubleshooting and diagnostic fault finding.
  • A sound experience with all types of agricultural and mechanical machinery.
  • High degree of confidence and or decision-making capability.
  • Focused under pressure, self-motivated, assertive, confident, fair, and open-minded.
  • Strong IT skills

Candidate profile

  • 5 years year’s + experience in a workshop or service centre environment
  • Experience in managing a large-scale maintenance.
  • Experience with maintenance of large scale agricultural and industrial equipment, and petrol and diesel engine Vehicles
  • Fully operational in the use of structured maintenance systems with a particular emphasis on a planned approach to preventive maintenance and recording and analysing data

job.title: Sustainability and Engagement Administrator - Agri
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are now inviting applications for the role of a Sustainability & Engagement Administrator.

Employer: FRS Co-Op
Location: Hybrid- 3 days office-based Bord Bia Headquarters, Dublin & 2 days remote working.
Contract: 12-month Full Time Fixed Term Contract with potential contract extension.
Hours: 9am - 5pm (flexitime), Monday to Friday working week.

Salary: €39,678 (fixed rate)

About the Role

FRS Recruitment is seeking an AgNav Sustainability & Engagement Administrator to support the delivery and continued development of AgNav, the sustainability platform developed in partnership by Bord Bia, Teagasc and ICBF.

Working closely with Bord Bia’s Agri Sustainability team and AgNav partners, the successful candidate will support farmers, processors, advisors and other stakeholders in the effective use of the platform.

This is a varied role combining agriculture, sustainability, stakeholder engagement, digital support and data analysis. AgNav-specific training will be provided.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the onboarding of AgNav users, including access, permissions and farmer consent processes.
  • Act as a single point of contact for processor administrative requests.
  • Manage data/reporting requests, supplier lists and account or access queries.
  • Deliver training, demonstrations and ongoing support to farmers and other platform users.
  • Engage with farmers, processors, advisors and industry stakeholders to encourage platform adoption, respond to queries and gather feedback.
  • Attend farm visits, workshops and industry events in support of AgNav engagement when required.
  • Liaise with the AgNav helpdesk, technical teams and partners to resolve user and platform issues.
  • Analyse sustainability data and support verification, reporting and stakeholder requirements.
  • Contribute to AgNav developments, including platform testing, user guidance, training materials and stakeholder communications.

Candidate Requirements

  • Good understanding of Irish agriculture and farm practices.
  • Knowledge of agricultural sustainability and relevant farm sustainability metrics.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with confidence engaging with farmers and industry representatives.
  • Experience delivering training, presentations or workshops.
  • Strong organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong IT skills, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
  • A proactive and practical approach, with the ability to work independently and as part of a wider team.

Desirable:

  • Experience in agricultural advisory, sustainability or agri-food roles; digital agriculture or sustainability platforms; sustainability data/reporting; Power BI; or stakeholder communications.
  • A relevant qualification in Agriculture, Agricultural Science, Sustainability, Environmental Science, Agri-Business or a related discipline would be desirable.
  • A full driving licence and flexibility to travel nationally will be required.
  • The successful candidate will be employed by FRS and will work closely with Bord Bia and the wider AgNav partnership.

  • Applications can ONLY be made through the provided link - internal or direct applications to Bord Bia will not be progressed

job.description:
HR Officer

Location: Naas, Co. Kildare

Permanent full time

Salary: €45,000 plus pension and healthcare contribution

Hybrid: 1 day remote working following probation

Purpose of the Role:

The HR officer plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth operation of the business by managing the workforce employee life cycle effectively. This includes Recruitment, Training and Development, Performance Management, Employee relations, Employee Benefits and Well-being as well as general daily administrative tasks.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist and advise management & staff on company policy queries and employee relations issues, complying with legislation and ensuring consistency across the organisation.
  • Complete all administration tasks in a timely fashion.
  • Lead bi weekly meetings with production managers.
  • Manage grievance & disciplinary investigations as required.
  • Working closely with hiring managers, manage recruitment processes end to end, from advertising posts through shortlisting of candidates, interviews, selection and job offers for all departments.

job.description:
Agri Plant Team Lead

Location: Goresbridge, Co. Kilkenny
Job Type: Full-Time

About the Opportunity

FRS Recruitment is hiring on behalf of a leading Irish agribusiness for an Agri Plant Team Lead to join their operation in Goresbridge, Co. Kilkenny.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced operator, production professional, or agricultural team member looking to take the next step into a leadership position. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting plant operations, leading a small team, and ensuring high standards of safety, quality, and efficiency.

The Role

As Agri Plant Team Lead, you will oversee day-to-day plant activities, coordinate production operations, and provide leadership and support to the wider team. This is a hands-on position suited to someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced agricultural or production environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coordinate, and support the plant team on a daily basis.
  • Allocate workloads and prioritise tasks to meet production targets.
  • Provide training, coaching, and guidance to team members.
  • Operate and oversee processing equipment and plant machinery.
  • Monitor product quality and ensure operational standards are maintained.
  • Support stock management, storage operations, and materials handling.
  • Operate forklifts and loading equipment where required.
  • Maintain accurate production and maintenance records.
  • Ensure compliance with all health, safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across the operation.

Who Should Apply?

This role would suit candidates from a variety of agricultural and production backgrounds, including:

  • Feed Mill Operators
  • Grain Store Operators
  • Seed Plant Operatives
  • Agri Production Operatives
  • Mill Operators

  • Co-op and Agri Merchant Employees
  • Food Production Operators
  • Manufacturing Operatives

  • Experience within an agricultural, grain, feed, seed, production, or manufacturing environment.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving ability.
  • Good organisational and communication skills.
  • A positive, hands-on approach to leadership.
  • A strong commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence.

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
Business Development Manager

Our client is seeking a commercially driven, new-business-focused Business Development Manager to accelerate growth across the property sector.

This is a genuine hunter role, suited to someone who enjoys identifying opportunities, building relationships from the ground up and converting prospects into long-term commercial partnerships.

You will be responsible for developing new business with property developers, landlords, property owners, investment groups and organisations managing residential or commercial property portfolios.

The focus will be on identifying decision-makers, understanding their requirements and presenting the solution as a commercially attractive proposition.

You will combine strong sales instincts with sufficient technical understanding to engage confidently with customers, explain the benefits of a solution and manage a consultative sales process.

This is an opportunity to develop a new market, build a substantial pipeline and turn individual customer wins into longer-term portfolio opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively identify, research and target new business opportunities across the property sector.
  • Develop and execute a structured business development strategy to generate new leads, secure meetings and convert prospects into customers.
  • Build and maintain a targeted pipeline of prospective clients, prioritising opportunities with strong commercial potential.
  • Develop an understanding of customers’ operational requirements, commercial objectives and investment considerations.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships across additional sites, developments or property portfolios.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the technology, installation process, platform and associated services.
  • Translate technical information into clear commercial benefits for customers.
  • Achieve agreed new business, revenue and pipeline targets.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, sales forecasts and regular pipeline reporting.
  • Work collaboratively with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition from winning new business to delivering the agreed solution.

We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded salesperson who is motivated by winning new business and building a market.

  • Proven experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong emphasis on new business acquisition.
  • A demonstrable track record of identifying opportunities, opening doors and converting prospects into paying customers.
  • Experience managing a consultative sales process involving multiple stakeholders and potentially longer sales cycles.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Full clean driving licence and willingness to travel to meet customers.

job.title: Community IV Nurse / Pharma Nurse
job.description:
Community IV Nurse / Pharma Nurse

Location: Leinster | Full-Time, Permanent

Salary: €50,000+ per annum + Company Car or Car Allowance + Excellent Benefits

FRS Recruitment is seeking an experienced and motivated Registered Nurse to join a growing healthcare service delivering specialist nursing care to patients in the community.

This is an excellent opportunity for a nurse who enjoys working independently, managing their own workload and delivering high-quality, patient-centred care outside the traditional hospital setting.

We are particularly interested in hearing from nurses with experience in pharmaceutical services, IV antibiotic therapy, infusion therapy or specialist community nursing.

About the Role

You will play a key role in delivering and coordinating specialist healthcare services for patients in their own homes and community settings across Leinster.

Working autonomously while collaborating with a wider clinical and operational team, you will support patients receiving IV antibiotics at home, virtual ward services and other specialist nursing interventions.

This role would suit a confident, clinically skilled nurse who enjoys autonomy, problem-solving and building relationships with patients and healthcare professionals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver safe, high-quality nursing care to patients in community settings.

  • Provide IV antibiotic therapy and other specialist nursing interventions in line with clinical protocols and your scope of practice.

  • Assess patients, monitor clinical progress and escalate concerns appropriately.

  • Coordinate care with hospitals, GPs, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals.

  • Educate and support patients and their families in managing treatment safely at home.

  • Maintain accurate clinical records and ensure compliance with clinical governance and patient safety standards.

  • Work independently, prioritising visits and managing your workload effectively.

  • Contribute to service development and continuous quality improvement.

Requirements

  • Current NMBI registration.

  • Relevant nursing qualification.

  • At least 5 years' registered nursing experience.

  • Experience in community nursing, IV therapies, infusion services or pharmaceutical healthcare is highly desirable.

  • Strong clinical assessment, decision-making and organisational skills.

  • Confidence working autonomously and managing a varied workload.

  • Excellent communication and IT skills, including Microsoft Outlook.

  • Current permission to work in Ireland.

Salary & Benefits

  • Salary from €50,000+ per annum, depending on experience.

  • Company car or car allowance.

  • Annual incentive and performance-related bonus opportunities.

  • Private health insurance.

  • Gym membership.

  • Laptop and mobile phone provided.

  • Flexible working arrangements.

  • Full-time, permanent position.

  • Opportunity to deliver innovative, patient-focused healthcare in the community.

Interested?

If you are a Registered Nurse looking for a more autonomous role where you can use your clinical expertise, build meaningful relationships with patients and enjoy the variety of community-based care, I would love to hear from you.

job.title: Quantity Surveyor (Tier 1)
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are currently recruiting for a Junior / Intermediate Quantity Surveyor to join a leading Tier 1 Main Contractor based in Cork City.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious Quantity Surveyor looking to develop their career with one of Ireland's leading Main Contractors, working alongside an experienced commercial team on major construction projects throughout Cork and the wider Munster region.

The company have a very strong pipeline of ongoing and upcoming projects, covering a mixture of commercial, residential, pharmaceutical and large-scale construction developments.

The position is not tied to one specific project, with the company open to discussing different project options depending on the successful candidate's experience, background and career goals.

The role would ideally suit a strong Junior Quantity Surveyor looking to take the next step in their career, or an Intermediate Quantity Surveyor seeking further experience on larger-scale projects.

The successful candidate will ideally have 2+ years' Quantity Surveying experience, preferably gained with a Main Contractor in Ireland or the UK.

The role will offer a mixture of office, hybrid and project-based working, with some travel required throughout Cork and the wider Munster region.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in managing project costs throughout the construction lifecycle.
  • Support subcontractor procurement, tender assessments and package appointments.
  • Prepare and review subcontractor valuations, variations and payment applications.
  • Assist with monthly cost reporting, valuations and financial forecasts.
  • Support cost-value reconciliations and ongoing project budget management.
  • Work closely with Senior Quantity Surveyors and commercial management teams.
  • Liaise with subcontractors, suppliers and project delivery teams.
  • Gain exposure to contractual matters and subcontractor final accounts.

Requirements

  • 2+ years' Quantity Surveying experience within the construction industry.
  • Previous experience with an Irish or UK Main Contractor preferred.
  • Degree qualification in Quantity Surveying or a related discipline.
  • Strong Junior or Intermediate Quantity Surveyor experience would be suitable.
  • Experience on residential, commercial or pharmaceutical projects would be advantageous.
  • Good understanding of subcontractor procurement, valuations and cost management.
  • Strong communication, organisational and commercial awareness skills.
  • Ambition to develop professionally within an established commercial team.

Salary & Benefits

  • Salary ranging from €45,000–€75,000, depending on experience.
  • Company vehicle and fuel card, or alternative fuel/travel allowance.
  • Pension contribution and private healthcare benefits provided.
  • Hybrid working available depending on project and team requirements.
  • Excellent career progression opportunities within a leading Tier 1 Contractor.

job.title: Operational / Programme Delivery Manager - 6 month FTC
job.description:
FRS is proud to partner with Aoibhneas in recruiting an Operational/Programme Delivery Manager for a 6-month fixed-term contract.

The Operational / Programme Delivery Manager will oversee the planning, coordination, monitoring and delivery of Aoibhneas services and programmes during a period of maternity leave cover. Reporting to the CEO, the successful candidate will provide operational leadership across service delivery, programme oversight, quality assurance, case auditing, reporting and performance monitoring, ensuring services continue to operate safely, effectively and in accordance with organisational policies, contractual obligations and best practice standards.

Key Responsibilities

Service Operations and Programme Delivery

  • Provide operational oversight of Aoibhneas services and programmes, ensuring safe, effective and consistent service delivery.
  • Support Coordinators and Team Leaders in implementing operational priorities, service plans and programme objectives.
  • Monitor service activity, outputs, outcomes and performance indicators, ensuring compliance with organisational and contractual requirements.
  • Identify operational risks, emerging trends and service improvement opportunities, escalating concerns and recommendations to the CEO.
  • Ensure services operate in accordance with organisational policies, procedures and quality standards.

Case Management, Quality Assurance and Compliance

  • Lead and coordinate case file audits, quality reviews and compliance monitoring across services.
  • Ensure adherence to safeguarding, GDPR, health and safety, case management and documentation standards.
  • Analyse client data and case management systems to identify trends, risks and opportunities for service improvement.
  • Support implementation of recommendations arising from audits, evaluations, inspections and quality reviews.
  • Promote best practice in Trauma-Informed Care, Domestic Abuse Interventions, Child Protection and culturally responsive practice.

Monitoring, Evaluation and Data Management

  • Oversee the collection, analysis and reporting of service and programme data.
  • Produce statistical, operational and performance reports for the CEO, funders and other stakeholders as required.
  • Monitor programme delivery against agreed objectives, timelines, funding requirements and key performance indicators.
  • Ensure accurate maintenance of databases, records and reporting systems.
  • Support organisational learning and service development through analysis of performance and outcome data.

Programme Oversight and Reporting

  • Monitor programme implementation to ensure delivery is aligned with agreed objectives, timelines, and funding requirements.
  • Coordinate reporting requirements for statutory, funded, and contractual programmes.
  • Support the preparation of quarterly, annual, and ad hoc reports as required.
  • Ensure programme activities are documented, monitored, and evaluated effectively.
  • Work collaboratively with managers to identify programme challenges and support solutions to maintain quality and continuity of delivery.

Staff Support, Leadership and Administration

  • Provide operational leadership and support to Coordinators and Team Leaders, promoting collaborative and effective working practices.
  • Support workforce planning, staff development and performance management processes as required.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement and staff wellbeing.
  • Support budget monitoring and ensure services operate within approved resources.
  • Contribute to funding, service review and organisational reporting requirements.
  • Contribute to maintaining staff wellbeing and effective team functioning during the maternity leave period.

Person Specification

Education and Qualifications

  • A relevant 3rd level qualification in Social Work/Care or related field essential
  • Professional management qualification, or working towards one, is desirable.
  • A full clean drivers license.

Essential Experience

  • Minimum 3 years' management or operational leadership experience within the social care, community, voluntary, healthcare or domestic violence sector.
  • Experience overseeing service delivery, programme implementation, quality assurance and performance monitoring.
  • Experience analysing service data and producing reports for management, funders and stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of safeguarding, risk management and regulatory compliance within frontline services.

Desirable

  • Experience within domestic, sexual, or gender-based violence services.
  • Experience managing funded programmes and reporting to statutory agencies and funders.

Role Requirements

Flexible to locations due to nature of service and working hours cover 5 days per week, Monday to Friday, between 9.am and 6pm.

Employer Benefits

  • Employer Pension Contribution of 5%.
  • Annual leave 28 days inclusive of 2 wellbeing days with incremental days in line with service.
  • Access to Digital GP Care and other benefits.
  • Access to Supervision and Employee Assistance Programme

My client, a leading agricultural machinery business is seeking an experienced Mechanic / Workshop Foreman to carry out mechanical repairs and support the day-to-day running of its workshop in Limerick.

This is a hands-on role, combining approximately 25 hours of mechanical work per week with workshop supervision, work allocation and quality control. You will work closely with the Service Manager, who oversees the wider service and administrative functions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Carry out servicing, diagnostics, maintenance and repairs on agricultural machinery and equipment.

  • Oversee the safe loading and unloading of deliveries.
  • Respond to out-of-hours service calls and assist with breakdown support, ensuring suitable cover is arranged when unavailable.
  • Help organise and participate in a seasonal weekend breakdown rota, liaising with the Kilrush team.

Skills and Experience

  • A relevant mechanical trade qualification or substantial experience servicing and repairing agricultural machinery.
  • Strong diagnostic, fault-finding and mechanical repair skills.
  • Experience supervising a workshop or providing guidance and support to other mechanics.
  • The ability to prioritise workloads, allocate tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Good communication skills and a practical approach to resolving technical and customer issues.
  • Ability to complete job cards and maintain computerised workshop records.
  • A strong commitment to quality workmanship and safe working practices.
  • Flexibility to participate in an agreed out-of-hours and seasonal weekend rota.

If you are an experienced mechanic looking to take on more responsibility while remaining hands-on, please send your CV to Kerry Rickard at FRS Recruitment or call 086 044 3981 for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Farm Maintenance Mechanic Manager
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are currently recruiting for a Farm Maintenance Manager (Machinery) for a large farm operation in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time permanent role.

Remuneration package

  • 97 days annual leave a year.
  • 6 free flights per year to and from Saudi Arabia
  • Accommodation Provided
  • Tax Free Salaries and Bonus
  • Vehicle
  • VIP Medical Cover

You will have responsibility and autonomy for scheduling maintenance for multiple Dairy farms. Our client is one of the largest vertically integrated dairy companies in the Middle East, managing over 195,000 dairy cows across seven modern dairy farms.

The FMM will work closely with farm workshop staff and demonstrate areas of improvement that can reduce costs / improve performance and reduce downtime on equipment. This will be a hands-on role where you will work with a multicultural workforce with a varying degree of ability.

The FMM will work side by side with the workshop team and transfer knowledge to them and help to improve their skills & ensure that the farm staff always keep updated service records.

Please note the ideal candidate for this role will be proficient in reading electrical and hydraulic drawings as you will be the contact for all mechanics when a breakdown arises.

Job overview

To plan and organize assigned farm mechanical maintenance staff so that the broad range of agricultural, industrial and animal feeding machinery and equipment is serviced, maintained and operated in accordance with company procedure. Train staff to ensure that competent and sufficient numbers of maintenance staff are available for the assigned farm sites.

Duties to include

  • To ensure that all maintenance staff are organised, trained and carry out all maintenance in accordance with all company Maintenance and Safety procedures for all farm agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment.
  • To ensure that all maintenance tasks are carried out in a safe manner and in accordance with company policy and standards.
  • To ensure all workshop buildings and surrounding areas, tools, lifting equipment and electrical equipment are in a clean and safe working condition.
  • To minimise the level of unplanned stoppages of machinery and reduce production losses due to machinery or equipment downtime.
  • To oversee routine and preventative maintenance of all agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment within the Division.
  • To monitor and assess the performance of all maintenance staff in conjunction with the Farming and Maintenance Manager and recommend training as require.
  • Liaise with suppliers to arrange warranty repairs.
  • Report issues that affect the reliability and running costs of equipment.
  • Arrange OEM training and access to required manuals for workshop staff.
  • Update company manuals that are used for maintaining and servicing machinery. Ensure that workshop staff are always following company manuals for servicing.
  • Identify parts that should be kept in the workshop central store that are necessary to keep equipment running. Ensure that the workshop store does not carry obsolete stock.
  • Navigate different manufacturers parts manuals / systems.
  • Arrange quotations from suppliers for the repair of equipment.

Core competencies

  • Excellent communicator with good influencing and person management skills.
  • A sound knowledge of troubleshooting and diagnostic fault finding.
  • A sound experience with all types of agricultural and mechanical machinery.
  • High degree of confidence and or decision-making capability.
  • Focused under pressure, self-motivated, assertive, confident, fair, and open-minded.
  • Strong IT skills

Candidate profile

  • 5 years year’s + experience in a workshop or service centre environment
  • Experience in managing a large-scale maintenance.
  • Experience with maintenance of large scale agricultural and industrial equipment, and petrol and diesel engine Vehicles
  • Fully operational in the use of structured maintenance systems with a particular emphasis on a planned approach to preventive maintenance and recording and analysing data

To apply

The overall development will deliver approximately 200 new homes across multiple phases, with a mix of semi-detached, terraced and detached properties. The wider masterplan also incorporates community facilities and significant supporting infrastructure.

Alongside the residential construction, the project includes estate roads, drainage networks, footpaths, public lighting, landscaping, parking areas and utility connections, providing excellent exposure across both building and infrastructure works.

The Quantity Surveyor will support the day-to-day commercial management and reporting of the development, working closely with an experienced Senior Quantity Surveyor/Commercial Manager. There will be strong ongoing support and guidance, with the opportunity to gradually take on greater commercial responsibility as your experience develops.

With approximately two years remaining on the current phase, alongside further planned phases and future developments, this is a strong opportunity for an ambitious Quantity Surveyor looking to build their experience on the developer side and establish a long-term career within a growing organisation.

Salary & Benefits

  • €45,000 - €60,000 depending on experience
  • Flexibility above this level for stronger relevant experience
  • Mileage support for project-related travel where applicable
  • Strong opportunity for continued career progression
  • Ongoing support from experienced senior commercial management
  • Potential hybrid flexibility following successful probation period

Responsibilities

  • Assist with commercial management of the residential development
  • Support project cost control, budgeting and financial reporting
  • Prepare valuations, payment applications and supporting documentation
  • Assist with subcontractor procurement, accounts and variations
  • Monitor site progress, materials and commercial project information
  • Support ongoing cost forecasting and project reporting activities
  • Liaise closely with site, design and commercial teams
  • Assist with final accounts and commercial record keeping

Requirements

  • Degree in Quantity Surveying or closely related discipline
  • One to three years’ Quantity Surveying experience in Ireland, ideally on residential projects
  • Residential construction experience would be particularly advantageous
  • Developer, contractor or consultancy backgrounds will be considered
  • Good understanding of construction costs and commercial processes
  • Strong numerical, analytical and Microsoft Excel capabilities
  • Excellent communication, organisation and attention to detail

job.title: Agri Sales Manager - Carlow
job.description:
Agri Sales Manager | Carlow

Location: Carlow Region
Job Type: Full-Time | Permanent

Join a Trusted Name in Irish Agriculture

FRS Recruitment is delighted to partner with one of Ireland's most respected and long-established agribusinesses in the search for an Agri Sales Manager covering the Carlow region.

With a proud heritage spanning over 100 years, our client has built a reputation for delivering quality products, trusted advice, and exceptional customer service to generations of farmers. As part of an ambitious growth strategy, they are now expanding their on-farm sales team and seeking an enthusiastic agricultural professional to further strengthen their presence across Carlow and the surrounding areas.

This role offers the opportunity to combine your agricultural knowledge with relationship-building and sales, helping farmers access the products and support they need to maximise farm performance.

Whether you're already working in agricultural sales or looking to take the next step from an agri merchant, co-op, feed sales, retail, or farm advisory background, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

The Opportunity

As an Agri Sales Manager, you will be the face of the business across your territory, developing strong working relationships with farmers while providing practical solutions and expert advice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and strengthen relationships with existing farm customers throughout the Carlow region.
  • Identify and secure new business opportunities to expand market share.
  • Provide on-farm advice and support across feed, fertiliser, animal health, and general farm inputs.
  • Promote the company's extensive range of agricultural products and services.
  • Build and manage a profitable customer portfolio with a focus on long-term partnerships.
  • Respond promptly to customer enquiries and deliver exceptional levels of customer service.
  • Work closely with management and internal support teams to ensure seamless customer support.
  • Meet and exceed sales targets while delivering sustainable business growth.
  • Maintain accurate customer records, sales activity, and reporting.

About You

We are seeking a driven and personable individual with a genuine passion for agriculture and a solid understanding of modern farming practices.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Agricultural qualification desirable but not essential.
  • Strong farming or agricultural background with a good understanding of livestock production and farm inputs.
  • Previous field sales experience within the agri sector would be advantageous.
  • Candidates currently working in agri retail, co-ops, merchants, animal nutrition, farm services, or technical support roles are encouraged to apply.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Commercial awareness with a customer-first approach.
  • Self-motivated and capable of managing your own territory.
  • Good IT and reporting skills.
  • Full clean driving licence.

What's on Offer?

  • Competitive salary package commensurate with experience.
  • Fully expensed company vehicle.
  • Mobile phone and laptop provided.
  • Opportunity to join a highly reputable and growing agribusiness.
  • Established customer base and strong local brand recognition.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Excellent long-term career progression opportunities.

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a business that has been supporting Irish farmers for generations. You'll benefit from the backing of a respected agricultural brand while enjoying the autonomy to develop your own territory and build meaningful, long-term relationships with farmers across Carlow.

If you're passionate about agriculture, enjoy working directly with farmers, and want to be part of a business that values customer relationships and long-term growth, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply Today

To apply, please submit your CV via the link provided.

All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence. FRS Recruitment will never disclose your personal details to any third party without your prior consent.

job.title: CNM1- Mental Health
