Permanent | Full-Time | 78 hours per fortnight

Make a Difference in Mental Health Care

We are seeking committed and experienced nursing professionals to join a multidisciplinary healthcare team providing person-centred care to adults with a range of mental health and neuropsychiatric needs. These roles offer an opportunity to contribute to high standards of clinical practice, service development and patient wellbeing within a supportive and inclusive working environment.

The Role

The Clinical Nurse Manager will support the effective delivery and ongoing development of nursing services, ensuring care is safe, compassionate, evidence-informed and aligned with relevant national standards, legislation and regulatory requirements. The post holder will work closely with patients/residents, families, carers and colleagues across the multidisciplinary team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the strategic and operational coordination, development and management of nursing services.
  • Promote high standards of clinical care, patient safety and a therapeutic, recovery-oriented environment.
  • Ensure compliance with clinical governance, regulatory requirements, health and safety, and risk management policies.
  • Contribute to service improvement and operational change initiatives.
  • Work collaboratively with patients/residents, families, carers and multidisciplinary colleagues in care planning and goal setting.
  • Support effective staff management, workforce planning and the appropriate use of resources.
  • Contribute to the education, supervision, training and professional development of nursing staff and students.
  • Ensure nursing practices, procedures and policies support organisational and service objectives.

Essential Requirements

  • Current registration as a Registered Psychiatric Nurse with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI), or eligibility to register where applicable.
  • Relevant post-registration nursing experience in mental health services.
  • Experience in a healthcare or hospital setting, including acute mental health care.
  • Strong clinical, organisational, managerial and administrative skills.
  • Knowledge of clinical governance, relevant mental health regulations, health and safety, and risk management.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team and demonstrate strong leadership and communication skills.
  • Commitment to ongoing professional and personal development.

Experience by Level

Clinical Nurse Manager 1 (CNM1): A minimum of three years’ post-registration nursing experience, including at least one year working in adult mental health services.

Clinical Nurse Manager 2 (CNM2): A minimum of five years’ post-qualification experience, including at least two years’ experience working as a Clinical Nurse Manager 1.

Experience in staff management, budget management and workforce planning is expected. Clinical experience in palliative care is desirable. Flexibility to work nights, weekends and public holidays may be required, depending on service needs.

What We’re Looking For

We welcome applicants who are compassionate, proactive and committed to delivering high-quality care. The successful candidate will demonstrate sound professional judgement, a collaborative approach and the ability to support colleagues while promoting safe, respectful and person-centred care.

To know more contact Sonal Tikariha

job.title: Accounts Assistant
job.description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Co. Offaly
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About the Role

We are currently recruiting an experienced Accounts Assistant to join an established motor dealership in Co Offaly.

This is a varied, hands-on role with responsibility for supporting and managing the dealership’s full day-to-day finance function. Working closely with management and the wider dealership team, the successful candidate will oversee sales and purchase ledger activities, payment runs, cash and bank reconciliations, cash flow management, vehicle sales processing and the financial administration of the parts and stocking departments.

This role would suit an organised and commercially minded accounts professional who enjoys taking ownership of the accounts function, working across different areas of the business and ensuring financial records and transactions are accurate and up to date.

Previous motor trade experience would be an advantage, but strong general accounts experience and a willingness to learn dealership-specific systems and processes are also important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the day-to-day accounts function, including sales ledger, purchase ledger and nominal ledger postings.

  • Process supplier invoices, customer invoices, credit notes and payment runs, ensuring transactions are accurately recorded and payments are made on time.

  • Complete daily cash and bank reconciliations, including cash takings, card payments, bank lodgements and customer receipts.

  • Monitor cash flow, outstanding payments and customer balances, assisting with credit control and resolving account queries.

  • Process new and used vehicle sales, including sales invoicing, new vehicle registrations, customer deposits, part-exchanges and finance company settlements.

  • Assist with vehicle purchasing and the stocking department, including processing purchase invoices, reconciling vehicle stock records and recording associated costs.

  • Manage the financial administration of the parts and service departments, including purchase and sales invoices, supplier reconciliations and daily takings.

  • Maintain accurate nominal ledger records, allocate income and expenditure correctly, and assist with month-end reporting and reconciliations.

  • Assist with VAT returns, financial reporting, audit requirements and maintaining appropriate financial controls.

  • Liaise with management and the sales, service, parts and stocking teams to resolve discrepancies and ensure the smooth running of the finance function.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant or similar full-function accounts role.

  • Strong practical knowledge of sales ledger, purchase ledger, nominal ledger and bank reconciliations.

  • Experience preparing payment runs and reconciling cash and bank transactions.

  • Good understanding of cash flow management and day-to-day financial controls.

  • Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software.

  • A proactive approach, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work closely with colleagues across different departments.

  • Previous experience in the motor trade or a dealership environment would be a distinct advantage.

To Apply:

If you have accounts experience and are looking for a varied role where you can take responsibility for the day-to-day finance function of a busy dealership, we would love to hear from you.

Send CV through the attached link or phone 086 4670069 for a confidential discussion about this opportunity

job.title: Site Supervisor / Works Coordinator
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are working with an established Civil Engineering Contractor to recruit a Site Supervisor / Works Coordinator for ongoing water and wastewater infrastructure projects across Cork City and surrounding areas.

The company have a strong reputation within the Irish construction industry, particularly in the water and wastewater sector, with an excellent pipeline of ongoing and upcoming projects across Ireland. They offer strong long-term stability and career development opportunities.

The role will involve coordinating and overseeing smaller-scale civil engineering works, primarily relating to the inspection, maintenance and repair of underground water and wastewater networks.

Projects will include CCTV surveying to identify defects within existing pipework, followed by excavation, repairs, pipe replacements and installation works where required.

This is a varied position, involving project coordination, subcontractor management, Health & Safety and general oversight of ongoing works. The role will involve a mixture of office-based responsibilities in Cork City and visits to local project sites.

The company are open to candidates from a variety of construction backgrounds, and an Engineering qualification or Trade background is not essential. Ideally, they are seeking someone who would be keen to take ownership of these operations on a long-term basis.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily site activities across multiple smaller-scale infrastructure projects.
  • Oversee CCTV surveying, excavation, pipe repairs and replacement works.
  • Manage subcontractors and ensure works progress safely and efficiently.
  • Monitor Health & Safety compliance across all ongoing site operations.
  • Assist with project scheduling, planning and allocation of resources.
  • Liaise with site teams, management and relevant project stakeholders.
  • Monitor progress, quality standards and completion of ongoing works.
  • Maintain project documentation, site records and general progress reports.

Requirements

We are seeking committed and experienced nursing professionals to join a multidisciplinary healthcare team providing person-centred care to adults with a range of mental health and neuropsychiatric needs. These roles offer an opportunity to contribute to high standards of clinical practice, service development and patient wellbeing within a supportive and inclusive working environment.

job.title: QC Validation Specialist
job.description:
Seeking a QC Validation Specialist !

This position plays a critical role in ensuring analytical methods are properly designed, validated and transferred in alignment with EU/FDA GMP requirements for advanced therapy products.

We are particularly interested in speaking with candidates who have hands-on experience designing validation studies, as well as authoring and reviewing validation protocols and reports—not just executing test methods developed by others. A genuine understanding of the regulatory landscape and the rationale behind validation activities is essential.

The Role

In this position, you will:

  • Lead and support the development, validation and technology transfer of new and established analytical methods for gene therapy products.

  • Design validation studies and generate validation protocols, data analysis summaries and comprehensive reports.

  • Ensure analytical methods are fully validated and transferred into QC GMP laboratories in line with regulatory expectations (EU/FDA, ICH Q2(R1), GMP, data integrity).

  • Create, update and maintain method SOPs and technical documentation.

  • Provide clear communication and progress updates to cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Conduct routine assessments of analytical methods to ensure continued control and suitability.

  • Support Quality Management System activities, including document control and data integrity oversight.

  • Maintain and track personal training, GMP compliance and document lifecycle responsibilities (deviations, CAPAs, change controls).

  • When required, perform analytical testing of gene therapy products according to approved specifications.

Candidate Profile

  • A degree or Master’s in a scientific discipline (e.g., Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry).

  • Approx. 2+ years’ experience in the pharmaceutical, biologics, or a similarly regulated environment.

  • Demonstrated experience in method validation, including:

    • Designing validation studies,

    • Writing and reviewing protocols and validation reports,

    • A strong understanding of regulatory requirements and data integrity.

  • Experience with analytical techniques (advantageous but not essential): qPCR, HPLC (RP-HPLC/SEC), ELISA, SDS-PAGE/Western blot, cell culture, DNA extraction.

  • Strong understanding of ICH Q2(R1).

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Keywords: QC Validation Chemist, Method Transfer Chemist, Analytical Chemist, Scientist, Chemist, Analytical Chemist, Scientist,Chemist, HPLC,GMP

job.title: Psychologist - Paediatrics HYBRID
job.description:
Psychologist – Children’s Services (Open to both Full time and part time)
Hybrid | Wicklow

A well-established, multi award-winning children’s services provider is seeking a Psychologist to join its growing multidisciplinary team. The service is grounded in strong values, ethical practice and a genuinely family-centred approach, offering children and their families clarity, understanding and practical pathways forward.

The clinic places a strong emphasis on collaboration, reflective practice and creating a supportive environment where clinicians feel valued, listened to and professionally fulfilled.

The Role
The Psychologist will work with children and families as part of a warm, experienced multidisciplinary team. While autism assessment forms a key part of the role, the position is embedded within a service that prioritises thoughtful, ethical practice and positive family experience over volume-driven work.

Key Responsibilities
• Completing autism diagnostic assessments with children and young people
• Administration, scoring and interpretation of ADOS-2 and/or ADI-R
• Contributing to multidisciplinary formulation and shared clinical decision-making
• Preparing clear, compassionate and high-quality assessment and diagnostic reports
• Providing feedback to parents and caregivers in a supportive, respectful manner
• Working closely with Occupational Therapists and other clinicians
• Maintaining clinical records in line with PSI and professional standards

Hybrid Working
This is a hybrid role. On-site attendance is required to conduct assessments with children and families, while remote working is possible for report writing, administration and other non-assessment tasks. The balance of on-site and remote work will support both service delivery and clinician flexibility.

Essential Criteria
• Recognised qualification in Psychology
• PSI registration
• Minimum 1 year experience working with children and young people in an assessment context
• Formal training and experience in ADOS-2 and/or ADI-R (essential)
• Strong clinical formulation, communication and report-writing skills
• A collaborative, values-led approach to clinical work

What the Service Offers
• A supportive, clinician-led environment with strong values and culture
• Genuine MDT collaboration and shared learning
• Flexible hybrid working arrangements
• Administrative support that protects clinical time
• A thoughtful, ethical approach to assessment and family care

job.title: Farm Maintenance Mechanic Manager
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are currently recruiting for a Farm Maintenance Manager (Machinery) for a large farm operation in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time permanent role.

Remuneration package

  • 97 days annual leave a year.
  • 6 free flights per year to and from Saudi Arabia
  • Accommodation Provided
  • Tax Free Salaries and Bonus
  • Vehicle
  • VIP Medical Cover

You will have responsibility and autonomy for scheduling maintenance for multiple Dairy farms. Our client is one of the largest vertically integrated dairy companies in the Middle East, managing over 195,000 dairy cows across seven modern dairy farms.

The FMM will work closely with farm workshop staff and demonstrate areas of improvement that can reduce costs / improve performance and reduce downtime on equipment. This will be a hands-on role where you will work with a multicultural workforce with a varying degree of ability.

The FMM will work side by side with the workshop team and transfer knowledge to them and help to improve their skills & ensure that the farm staff always keep updated service records.

Please note the ideal candidate for this role will be proficient in reading electrical and hydraulic drawings as you will be the contact for all mechanics when a breakdown arises.

Job overview

To plan and organize assigned farm mechanical maintenance staff so that the broad range of agricultural, industrial and animal feeding machinery and equipment is serviced, maintained and operated in accordance with company procedure. Train staff to ensure that competent and sufficient numbers of maintenance staff are available for the assigned farm sites.

Duties to include

  • To ensure that all maintenance staff are organised, trained and carry out all maintenance in accordance with all company Maintenance and Safety procedures for all farm agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment.
  • To ensure that all maintenance tasks are carried out in a safe manner and in accordance with company policy and standards.
  • To ensure all workshop buildings and surrounding areas, tools, lifting equipment and electrical equipment are in a clean and safe working condition.
  • To minimise the level of unplanned stoppages of machinery and reduce production losses due to machinery or equipment downtime.
  • To oversee routine and preventative maintenance of all agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment within the Division.
  • To monitor and assess the performance of all maintenance staff in conjunction with the Farming and Maintenance Manager and recommend training as require.
  • Liaise with suppliers to arrange warranty repairs.
  • Report issues that affect the reliability and running costs of equipment.
  • Arrange OEM training and access to required manuals for workshop staff.
  • Update company manuals that are used for maintaining and servicing machinery. Ensure that workshop staff are always following company manuals for servicing.
  • Identify parts that should be kept in the workshop central store that are necessary to keep equipment running. Ensure that the workshop store does not carry obsolete stock.
  • Navigate different manufacturers parts manuals / systems.
  • Arrange quotations from suppliers for the repair of equipment.

Core competencies

  • Excellent communicator with good influencing and person management skills.
  • A sound knowledge of troubleshooting and diagnostic fault finding.
  • A sound experience with all types of agricultural and mechanical machinery.
  • High degree of confidence and or decision-making capability.
  • Focused under pressure, self-motivated, assertive, confident, fair, and open-minded.
  • Strong IT skills

Candidate profile

  • 5 years year’s + experience in a workshop or service centre environment
  • Experience in managing a large-scale maintenance.
  • Experience with maintenance of large scale agricultural and industrial equipment, and petrol and diesel engine Vehicles
  • Fully operational in the use of structured maintenance systems with a particular emphasis on a planned approach to preventive maintenance and recording and analysing data

job.description:
Talent Acquisition & Retention Lead - HGV / Driver

Permanent full time

Location: Co. Cavan

Office based - Potential flexibility post probation

Overview:

You’ll own the full driver journey, from recruitment and onboarding through to engagement and retention. Working closely with the Driver Management Team, you’ll develop innovative initiatives that strengthen our driver proposition and create a supportive, engaging environment where drivers feel valued and motivated to stay.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the company's annual and seasonal driver recruitment strategy and plans to meet workforce plans / targets.
  • Recruit drivers through multiple channels including but not limited to; existing driver networks, alumni drivers, employee referrals, social media, recruitment agencies, driver training schools, apprenticeship programs, international recruitment initiatives, job boards and specialist transport recruitment platforms
  • Oversee the design, content and effectiveness of the company's driver recruitment website and related company digital recruitment platforms.

  • Design and manage all driver screening and selection processes.
  • Develop selection criteria to ensure the recruitment of high-performing drivers who align with company values.
  • Coordinate Interviews, Assessments, driving evaluations, Qualification & Certifications Compliance and right to work employment checks and medical assessments where required
  • Manage candidate and business stakeholder expectations throughout the recruitment process.
  • Design, implement and manage structured onboarding programs.
  • Ensure probation reviews are completed for all drivers within 1 month, co-ordinate review & sign off for Head of Driver Management and transition successful candidates to Performance & Comp Lead.

  • Experience in employer branding and social media recruitment.

job.title: Farm Maintenance Mechanic Manager
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are currently recruiting for a Farm Maintenance Manager (Machinery) for a large farm operation in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time permanent role.

Remuneration package

  • 97 days annual leave a year.
  • 6 free flights per year to and from Saudi Arabia
  • Accommodation Provided
  • Tax Free Salaries and Bonus
  • Vehicle
  • VIP Medical Cover

You will have responsibility and autonomy for scheduling maintenance for multiple Dairy farms. Our client is one of the largest vertically integrated dairy companies in the Middle East, managing over 195,000 dairy cows across seven modern dairy farms.

The FMM will work closely with farm workshop staff and demonstrate areas of improvement that can reduce costs / improve performance and reduce downtime on equipment. This will be a hands-on role where you will work with a multicultural workforce with a varying degree of ability.

The FMM will work side by side with the workshop team and transfer knowledge to them and help to improve their skills & ensure that the farm staff always keep updated service records.

Please note the ideal candidate for this role will be proficient in reading electrical and hydraulic drawings as you will be the contact for all mechanics when a breakdown arises.

Job overview

To plan and organize assigned farm mechanical maintenance staff so that the broad range of agricultural, industrial and animal feeding machinery and equipment is serviced, maintained and operated in accordance with company procedure. Train staff to ensure that competent and sufficient numbers of maintenance staff are available for the assigned farm sites.

Duties to include

  • To ensure that all maintenance staff are organised, trained and carry out all maintenance in accordance with all company Maintenance and Safety procedures for all farm agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment.
  • To ensure that all maintenance tasks are carried out in a safe manner and in accordance with company policy and standards.
  • To ensure all workshop buildings and surrounding areas, tools, lifting equipment and electrical equipment are in a clean and safe working condition.
  • To minimise the level of unplanned stoppages of machinery and reduce production losses due to machinery or equipment downtime.
  • To oversee routine and preventative maintenance of all agricultural, industrial and feeding machinery and equipment within the Division.
  • To monitor and assess the performance of all maintenance staff in conjunction with the Farming and Maintenance Manager and recommend training as require.
  • Liaise with suppliers to arrange warranty repairs.
  • Report issues that affect the reliability and running costs of equipment.
  • Arrange OEM training and access to required manuals for workshop staff.
  • Update company manuals that are used for maintaining and servicing machinery. Ensure that workshop staff are always following company manuals for servicing.
  • Identify parts that should be kept in the workshop central store that are necessary to keep equipment running. Ensure that the workshop store does not carry obsolete stock.
  • Navigate different manufacturers parts manuals / systems.
  • Arrange quotations from suppliers for the repair of equipment.

Core competencies

  • Excellent communicator with good influencing and person management skills.
  • A sound knowledge of troubleshooting and diagnostic fault finding.
  • A sound experience with all types of agricultural and mechanical machinery.
  • High degree of confidence and or decision-making capability.
  • Focused under pressure, self-motivated, assertive, confident, fair, and open-minded.
  • Strong IT skills

Candidate profile

  • 5 years year’s + experience in a workshop or service centre environment
  • Experience in managing a large-scale maintenance.
  • Experience with maintenance of large scale agricultural and industrial equipment, and petrol and diesel engine Vehicles
  • Fully operational in the use of structured maintenance systems with a particular emphasis on a planned approach to preventive maintenance and recording and analysing data

job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
Quality Manager-Cork

Excellent salary package + bonus, pension & healthcare

Please note: This position is open to candidates who already have the legal right to work in Ireland. Visa sponsorship or work permit support is not available for this position.

A well-established Cork based food manufacturer is continuing to expand its operations and is now seeking an experienced Quality Manager to join the team.

The business manufactures a wide range of nutritional products serving multiple sectors, with a strong focus on quality, food/feed safety, compliance and continuous improvement.

The business is undergoing significant expansion, including the construction of a new production facility and a major increase in manufacturing capacity. This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in developing and strengthening the Quality function as the business grows.

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead and manage the Quality function across all manufacturing operations, ensuring strong quality performance, product release and robust compliance systems.
  • Maintain effective traceability and batch record systems, ensuring accuracy, integrity and accessibility of records.
  • Lead regulatory and certification compliance, ensuring adherence to DAFM, HACCP, UFAS, NOPS, GMP+ and relevant customer and industry standards.
  • Manage the Quality Management System (QMS) and document control processes.
  • Develop and oversee the analytical testing programme, using HACCP and risk assessment principles.
  • Lead the internal audit programme and manage all external audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring findings are addressed promptly.
  • Oversee supplier approval, raw material change control and cross-functional assessment of quality and regulatory impacts.
  • Manage the customer complaints process, ensuring effective investigation, corrective action and timely closure.
  • Lead non-conformance, root cause analysis and corrective action, driving continuous improvement across the site.
  • Monitor and trend key quality and site performance metrics, leading quality review meetings and follow-up actions.
  • Develop team capability through effective training, coaching and support.
  • Work closely with Operations, Technical, Commercial and other functions to deliver site objectives and maintain high standards of quality and compliance.

Experience & Skills

  • Prior experience as a Quality Manager in a production processing environment
  • 10 years minimum experience in a pharma or food production environment.
  • Degree in a Science related subject
  • Level 5 or higher HACCP certification
  • Strong leadership and management skills
  • Excellent understanding of Food Safety and Quality Management Systems, with strong knowledge of food/feed legislation, customer standards and Codes of Practice
  • Formal Audit Training / Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor experience

What's in it for you?

  • Excellent salary package DOE
  • Performance-related bonus
  • Pension
  • Healthcare
  • Opportunity to join a business undergoing significant expansion
  • Major investment in a new production facility
  • Opportunity to play a key role in developing and strengthening the Quality function as the business grows

job.title: Agri Machinery Assembly & Repairs
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are now recruiting for a Farm Machinery Assembly & Repairs person.

This is a fulltime, permanent role based in central Galway (25min East of Galway City)

Our Client is proud to support farmers with a comprehensive range of agri products, services, and expert advice.

The successful candidate will come with with a strong understanding of agricultural machinery, excellent mechanical ability and good knowledge of farm machinery spare parts.

As a member of the Farm Machinery Assembly & Repairs team, you will be involved in assembling, servicing, diagnosing and repairing a wide range of agricultural machinery and equipment. You will need to be comfortable working independently, solving mechanical problems and identifying the correct replacement parts to get machinery back working efficiently.

Strong spare-parts knowledge is particularly important for this position. You should be confident identifying components, checking compatibility and finding the correct parts required for repairs and assembly. A formal qualification in agricultural mechanics is an advantage, but hands-on experience and the right technical ability will be highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assemble new farm machinery and agricultural implements to a high standard.
  • Carry out servicing, maintenance and mechanical repairs on agricultural machinery.
  • Diagnose mechanical, hydraulic and electrical faults and identify appropriate repairs.
  • Inspect machinery and components to identify wear, damage and potential problems.
  • Identify and source the correct spare parts and replacement components.
  • Use parts diagrams, manuals and technical information to identify components.
  • Maintain accurate records of repairs, servicing and parts used.
  • Prepare machinery for delivery, sale or return to customers.
  • Assist with the inspection and preparation of machinery coming into the business.
  • Maintain a clean, organised and safe workshop.
  • Work safely and follow appropriate workshop and company procedures.
  • Provide practical technical support to colleagues and customers where required.
  • Take ownership of jobs from diagnosis through to completion.

Essential Requirements

  • Previous experience working with agricultural/farm machinery.
  • Strong mechanical and practical skills.
  • Proven experience in machinery assembly, servicing and repairs.
  • Good knowledge of agricultural machinery spare parts and components.
  • The ability to identify parts using diagrams, catalogues and technical information.
  • Strong fault-finding and problem-solving abilities.
  • The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Good attention to detail and pride in the quality of your work.
  • A strong understanding of workshop health and safety.
  • A full driving licence.

Desirable Experience with the following:

  • Tractors and loaders
  • Balers
  • Mowers and grass machinery
  • Tillage equipment
  • Trailers and agricultural implements
  • Hydraulic systems
  • Electrical fault-finding
  • Welding and fabrication
  • Agricultural machinery dealerships or workshops
  • Agricultural machinery parts departments
